system.description:
In life, you were either Jewish or Muslim and have retained your faith through the Embrace. As both religions forbid their followers from tasting, let alone drinking, blood, this creates a moral dilemma. Even animal blood is a forbidden substance, and your conscience pricks whenever you feed.

This is a variable Flaw. At two Traits, you voluntarily restrict your feeding to animals or blood drained by a ritual butcher. At four Traits, you refuse to feed unless it is an immediate necessity (your Blood Traits are reduced to three or fewer), and even then you may fall victim to depression and self-loathing for several nights afterward.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Two
